0022600189.text: The Indiana Pacers (3-6, 10th in the East) come into this 10th game of their season on a one-game winning streak, and the Denver Nuggets (3-3, 10th in the West) are on a one-game losing streak, with the game played at a neutral site in Mexico City. The Pacers are missing Ben Sheppard (knee), Johnny Furphy (knee, surgery), Kelly Oubre Jr. (calf bruise), T.J. McConnell (hamstring strain) and Tyrese Haliburton (hamstring strain), while the Nuggets are without DeMar DeRozan (back spasms), Julian Strawther (knee sprain) and Spencer Jones (hamstring). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and the Pacers lost their 2025-26 season series 0-2, including a 135-120 defeat in Indianapolis on December 3, 2025.
